exposure: Fresh transfer group: 220 patients with live singleton deliveries following IVF with fresh embryo transfer (matched 1:5 to OHSS group based on maternal age and parity)
OHSS group: 44 patients with live singleton deliveries after IVF complicated by OHSS
FET group: 220 patients with live singleton deliveries following IVF with frozen embryo transfer (matched 1:5 to OHSS group based on maternal age and parity)
Ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome (OHSS) following IVF treatment
outcome: Small for gestational age neonate rate
cohort: 264 women who underwent IVF and had a live singleton delivery, including those who experienced OHSS and those who did not.
finding: Women who experienced OHSS in early IVF pregnancy had a significantly higher risk of placental abruption compared to those who underwent fresh or frozen embryo transfer.
birth_weight: OHSS group: 3017 +/- 483 grams; Fresh transfer group: 3057 +/- 545 grams; FET group: 3213 +/- 542 grams
